text: But there’s one thing I know sure, an’ that there’s no gettin’ away from.” The dog-musher paused and nodded his head confidentially at Moosehide Mountain. “Well, don’t be a miser with what you know,” Scott said sharply, after waiting a suitable length of time. “Spit it out. What is it?” The dog-musher indicated White Fang with a backward thrust of his thumb. “Wolf or dog, it’s all the same—he’s ben tamed ’ready.” “No!” “I tell you yes, an’ broke to harness.
